findings.name: Electricity

methodology.standard: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard
methodology.boundary: Single facility · operational control · one declared year
limitations: Emission factors are literature values and need verification against current primary sources before commercial use.
Peer percentiles are indicative screening benchmarks, not a surveyed or accredited corpus.
CAPEX and savings are planning-grade estimates; a site survey and vendor quotation remain necessary.
Activity inputs are declared. No bills, meters or implementation outcomes are verified.
Within-stream interaction is de-rated. Cross-stream overlap may remain.
Scope 1 excludes mobile combustion, fugitive refrigerants and process emissions such as calcination.
Scope 2 is location-based only; purchased steam and market-based instruments are excluded.
Scope 3 is limited to modelled purchased materials, waste and freight. Other categories are unavailable, not zero.
CBAM uses an indicative reference price and excludes precursors. Confirm current goods coverage, applicable rules and certificate price.
This is a single-year, single-facility snapshot. No trend or seasonality is inferred.
